def find_max_hamming_distance(N, A):
    # The maximum Hamming distance is achieved by placing the two unique elements of A
    # as far apart as possible in the array B. Since the frequency of each element is at most 2,
    # we can always achieve a Hamming distance of N-1 by placing one element at the start
    # and the other at the end of the array.
    unique_elements = sorted(set(A))
    B = [0] * N
    B[0] = unique_elements[1]
    B[-1] = unique_elements[0]
    return B

def main():
    T = int(input())
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input())
        A = list(map(int, input().split()))
        B = find_max_hamming_distance(N, A)
        print(N - 1)
        print(*B)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
